games.title: Elden Ring
games.summary: The Golden Order has been broken. Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.summary: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in a tale of fellowship and betrayal, sacrifice and survival, and the lure of absolute power.

games.title: Resident Evil 4 (Remake)
games.summary: Survival is only the beginning. Six years have passed since the disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy tracks the presidents missing daughter to a secluded European village.

games.title: Resident Evil 2 (Remake)
games.summary: A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the town into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets.

games.title: Resident Evil Village
games.summary: Experience survival horror like never before in Resident Evil Village. Years after the tragic events of RE7, Ethan Winters seeks answers in a mysterious snowy village.

games.title: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard
games.summary: Menace and desperation pulse through the decaying walls of an abandoned southern farmhouse. RE7 marks a dramatic shift to an intense first-person perspective.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.summary: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer. Before you stands a war-torn, monster-infested continent you can explore at will.

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.summary: An open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the megalopolis of Night City, where you play as a cyberpunk mercenary wrapped in a do-or-die fight for survival.

games.title: Hollow Knight
games.summary: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns and battle tainted creatures.

games.title: Hades
games.summary: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from the creators of Bastion and Transistor.

games.title: Hades II
games.summary: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

games.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
games.summary: Carve your own clever path to vengeance in the critically acclaimed adventure from developer FromSoftware, creators of Bloodborne and the Dark Souls series.

games.title: Dark Souls III
games.summary: As fires fade and the world falls into ruin, journey into a universe filled with more colossal enemies and environments. Immersive gameplay with faster combat.

games.title: Bloodborne
games.summary: Face your fears as you search for answers in the ancient city of Yharnam, now cursed with a strange endemic illness spreading through the streets like wildfire.

games.title: Persona 5 Royal
games.summary: Don the mask of Joker and join the Phantom Thieves of Hearts. Break free from the chains of modern society and stage grand heists to infiltrate the minds of the corrupt.

games.title: Persona 3 Reload
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a transfer student thrust into an unexpected fate when entering the hour hidden between one day and the next. Awaken an incredible power.

games.title: Chrono Trigger
games.summary: The timeless RPG classic developed by the dream team of Yuji Horii, Akira Toriyama, and Hironobu Sakaguchi. Journey across forgotten eras to save the future.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
games.summary: The unknown journey continues. After escaping from the dystopian city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.summary: Cloud Strife, an ex-SOLDIER operative, descends on Midgar. The world has fallen under the control of the Shinra Electric Power Company.

games.title: Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster
games.summary: Follow Tidus, a star Blitzball player who journeys with a young summoner named Yuna to save the world of Spira from an endless cycle of destruction caused by Sin.

games.title: Final Fantasy IX
games.summary: Zidane and the Tantalus Theater Troupe have kidnapped Princess Garnet, the heir of Alexandria. To their surprise, however, the princess herself yearned to escape the castle.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
games.summary: An epic adventure across the land and skies of Hyrule awaits in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom for Nintendo Switch. Create your own path through the sprawling landscape.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
games.summary: Step into a world of discovery, exploration, and adventure in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, a boundary-breaking new game in the acclaimed series.

games.title: Balatro
games.summary: Balatro is a poker-inspired roguelike deck builder all about creating powerful synergies and winning big. Combine valid poker hands with unique Joker cards.

games.title: Slay the Spire
games.summary: We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power.

games.title: Outer Wilds
games.summary: Named Game of the Year 2019 by Giant Bomb, Polygon, Eurogamer, and The Guardian, Outer Wilds is a critically-acclaimed and award-winning open world mystery about a solar system trapped in a 22-minute time loop.

games.title: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
games.summary: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is the definitive edition of the groundbreaking role playing game. You are a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across.

games.title: Celeste
games.summary: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain, in this super-tight, hand-crafted platformer from the creators of multiplayer classic TowerFall.

games.title: Lies of P
games.summary: Lies of P is a thrilling soulslike that takes the story of Pinocchio, turns it on its head, and sets it against the darkly elegant backdrop of the Belle Époque era.

games.title: Alan Wake 2
games.summary: Saga Anderson arrives to investigate ritualistic murders in a small town. Alan Wake pens a dark story to shape the reality around him. Two heroes connected in ways they cannot understand.

games.title: God of War Ragnarök
games.summary: Kratos and Atreus must journey to each of the Nine Realms in search of answers as Asgardian forces prepare for a prophesied battle that will end the world.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.summary: America, 1899. Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing, the gang must rob, steal and fight across the rugged heartland.

games.title: Silent Hill 2 (Remake)
games.summary: Having received a letter from his deceased wife, James heads to where they shared so many memories in the foggy town of Silent Hill. What he finds is a town veiled in fog and haunted by nightmares.

games.title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
games.summary: As Alucard, the dhampir son of Count Dracula, explore the shifting labyrinth of Draculas demonic castle to rid the world of the vampiric terror once and for all.

games.title: Super Mario World
games.summary: Mario and Luigi head to Dinosaur Land where Bowser has kidnapped Princess Toadstool and sealed Yoshi in a magic egg. Travel through Dinosaur Land and master cape flight.

games.title: Portal 2
games.summary: The "Perpetual Testing Initiative" has been expanded to allow you to design co-op puzzles for you and your friends! Break testing records with Chell and GLaDOS.

games.title: Half-Life 2
games.summary: By taking the crowbar of research scientist Gordon Freeman, you find yourself on an alien-infested Earth being picked to the bone, its resources depleted, its populace dwindling.

games.title: BioShock Remastered
games.summary: BioShock is a shooter unlike any you have ever played, loaded with weapons and tactics never seen. Explore Rapture, an undersea paradise turned dystopian nightmare.

games.title: NieR:Automata
games.summary: Invaders from another world attack without warning, unleashing machine lifeforms. In the face of this seemingly insurmountable threat, humanity is driven from the Earth.

games.title: Dragon's Dogma 2
games.summary: Dragons Dogma 2 is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges the players to choose their own experience from the appearance of their Arisen to their vocation.

games.title: Sea of Stars
games.summary: Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG inspired by the classics. It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic.

games.title: Dave the Diver
games.summary: DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, singleplayer adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night.

games.title: Dead Cells
games.summary: Dead Cells is a rogue-lite, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You will explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you are able to fight your way past its keepers.

games.title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
games.summary: A new action game based on the concept of the ARMORED CORE series that uses the knowledge gained from FromSoftwares recent action game development.

games.title: Street Fighter 6
games.summary: Here comes Capcoms newest challenger! Powered by Capcoms proprietary RE ENGINE, the Street Fighter 6 experience spans across three distinct game modes.

games.title: Hi-Fi RUSH
games.summary: Feel the beat as wannabe rockstar Chai and his ragtag team of allies rebel against an evil robotics corporation in slick rhythm combat!

games.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon
games.summary: Become Ichiban Kasuga, a low-ranking yakuza grunt left on the brink of death by the man he trusted most. Take up your legendary bat and get ready to crack some underworld skulls in dynamic RPG combat.

games.title: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater
games.summary: Origin of the legendary operative Snake. Infiltrate a Soviet military jungle fortress during the Cold War to rescue a defecting rocket scientist and eliminate your mentor, The Boss.

games.title: Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR’S CUT
games.summary: In the late 13th century, the Mongol empire has laid waste to entire nations. Jin Sakai must do whatever it takes, and forge the way of the Ghost, to protect his people.

resident-evil-4-remake.review: O remake absoluto. A Capcom conseguiu honrar cada segundo do clássico de 2005 e modernizar a física, o combate com a faca e o clima sombrio do vilarejo.

baldirs-gate-3.review: A liberdade narrativa é algo sem precedentes nos últimos 15 anos. Cada escolha realmente parece moldar o destino do grupo.

ffvii-rebirth.review: A escala do mundo, os minigames do Queen’s Blood e o aprofundamento das relações entre Cloud, Tifa, Aerith e Barret foram surreais.

elden-ring.review: Uma jornada monumental. O sentimento de descoberta ao entrar em Leyndell ou descer até o Rio Siofra é algo que jamais esquecerei.

bloodborne.review: A obra máxima de Hidetaka Miyazaki. O som do sino de Yharnam e a agressividade nas esquivas são arte pura.

hollow-knight.review: A trilha sonora de Christopher Larkin combinada à exploração em camadas de Hallownest colocam esse jogo no topo dos meus favoritos.

balatro.review: Simplesmente não consigo parar de abrir uma partida rápida antes de dormir. O som das fichas subindo é hipnótico.

chrono-trigger.review: Jogado pela primeira vez nos anos 90 e rejogado inúmeras vezes. O ritmo é impecável, zero enrolação e personagens que marcaram minha vida.

outer-wilds.review: Não procure spoilers, apenas jogue. Uma obra prima existencial sobre o universo e nossa breve passagem nele.

cyberpunk-2077.review: Após o update 2.0 e Phantom Liberty, Night City se tornou a cidade mais viva e atmosférica dos videogames.

logs.review: Consegui quebrar o Ante 8 usando um combo insano de Baralho Vermelho e multiplicadores de Flush!
Chegando às Torres do Alvorecer. As escolhas morais com o Shadowheart estão me deixando sem fôlego.
Créditos finais rolando após 85 horas de campanha! Batalha final espetacular e muita nostalgia.
Passando do 5º bloco de Tartarus. A nova trilha sonora com a Lotus Juice é viciante.
Zerei a campanha no modo Hardcore! Leon chutando zumbis com precisão militar. 10/10.
